coding.display: CT Abdomen WO and W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Multiphase liver CT. Two arterially enhancing masses with portal venous washout in the right hepatic lobe: 7.8 cm in segment 7 and 2.1 cm in segment 6 (LI-RADS 5), consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma. No portal or hepatic vein invasion. Background liver with features of chronic liver disease; no ascites. Left lobe clear. No abdominal lymphadenopathy or extrahepatic disease.
Liver, right lobe, hepatectomy: hepatocellular carcinoma, two tumors (7.8 cm and 2.1 cm). Margins negative. Background liver: chronic hepatitis, inactive, with fibrosis. Pathologic stage pT3 pN0.

coding.display: CT Abdomen WO and W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Post-resection baseline. Expected changes after right hepatectomy, with hypertrophy of the left lobe. No residual or recurrent tumor. No ascites or abdominal lymphadenopathy.

coding.display: CT Chest and Abdomen and Pelvis W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Recurrence. New 2.6 cm arterially enhancing lesion with washout in the left hepatic lobe (segment 3), consistent with recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma. Multiple new bilateral pulmonary nodules, the largest 1.4 cm in the right lower lobe, consistent with metastases. Post-hepatectomy changes. No lymphadenopathy.

coding.display: CT Chest and Abdomen W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Progression since 2026-05-02. Bilateral pulmonary metastases increased in size and number, the largest now 2.2 cm (previously 1.4 cm). Left hepatic lobe recurrence enlarged to 3.9 cm (previously 2.6 cm).

coding.display: MR Abdomen WO and W contrast IV

resource.conclusion: Left hepatic lobe recurrence, 4.0 cm, with arterial enhancement and washout, enlarged since 2026-05-02. New 1.2 cm nodule in segment 2. No portal vein tumor thrombus. No ascites.

note.text: 24-year-old man with recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma (initially stage IIIA), with liver and lung recurrence after resection, progression on sorafenib, and now on a clinical trial (tazemetostat). Presented for review of treatment options in light of tumor genomic results.
